description: List the indexes whose membership TickerDB tracks (sp500, sp400, sp600, sp100, nasdaq100, russell1000, russell2000), each with the fund it is read from (e.g. IVV for the S&P 500), its first covered date (late 2019) and today's member count. Membership is the SEC Form N-PORT holdings of a fully replicating fund, point in time by filing date: typically 2-5 months behind the index provider's own changes. Use the ids with get_index_members, or as member_of in get_universe / get_search. Costs 1 credit.
name: get_indexes
